TC-17/S24.title: axe + phone checks on Post-Round screens, Pending Tasks and Ask sheets (own extension)
TC-17/S24.detail: pr-tc17-s24-a11y.spec.ts, desktop Chromium, Pixel 7 Chromium, iPhone 15 on WebKit (ran), both contexts, 30 screens. Not in UAT/ticket: QA-improvement findings only. Every screen: axe color-contrast (serious). NH: back button, task complete/delete icons unnamed (button-name), note/tasks/meds toggles expose no aria-pressed (Hospital does). Ask sheet (both): no dialog role, close X unnamed. Pending Tasks sheet is a named dialog. Small (<24 px) tap targets on every screen (icon buttons). No sideways scroll anywhere.
